text: A Song of Ascents. When ADONAI restored the captives of Zion, it was as if we were dreaming.
Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with a song of joy. Then they said among the nations, “ADONAI has done great things for them.”
ADONAI has done great things for us — we are joyful!
Restore us from captivity, ADONAI, like streams in the Negev.
Those who sow in tears will reap with a song of joy.
Whoever keeps going out weeping, carrying his bag of seed, will surely come back with a song of joy, carrying his sheaves.
